requirement_text: The verdict is a pure function, reading no clock or environment
Preconditions gate the graded layers
Every breached rule is reported, not only the first
A run measuring nothing is never green
No metric divides without testing its denominator
Dependency and unsupported skips are excluded from the skip denominator
An expired quarantine entry fails the run
Layer semantics are read from registration, never hardcoded
Every flag that can change a result is recorded in metadata
Run-scoped fields are emitted per result, not only in a manifest
A verdict requires a gated run, and `gated` is derived rather than set
An ungated artifact is refused rather than scored
A diagnostic run returns no verdict code
Only a harness-computed selection yields a verdict
Debug artifacts are excluded structurally and by row marking
Every emitted and referenced taxonomy code is registered
Inventory counts match their rows
Traceability is verified in both directions, and derived columns match their source
An unknown named test is an error rather than an empty run, established by --tests since 2026-10-03; --case is retired and its two cases with it
notes: Covered by 112114, 112115 and 112116 until 2026-10-03 and established by none of them: 112114 asserted that two string literals it had just written differ, 112115 asserted the retired flag reached metadata, and 112116 is about --observations. The behaviour is first implemented by --tests

requirement_text: A verdict is recomputable from stored artifacts
Each verdict rule produces the correct outcome at its threshold and on either side of it
Demotion follows match count, is reported, and security cases are never demoted
notes: An unreported demotion satisfies a ceiling by shrinking the number

requirement_text: The distribution check abstains below the minimum sample rather than publishing a verdict
Options are declared once and yield identical flags to both surfaces, with an invalid value rejected at parse time
An observation is assembled from tier results and case metadata
A truncated duration is excluded from latency statistics
Candidate content never enters the judge's instruction portion
The injection screen is programmatic and makes no model call
A screen hit aborts an ordinary case and grades a declared adversarial one
Assertions gate the case outcome conjunctively
Judging after an assertion failure is off unless requested, and never follows a fatal failure
A skipped judgement is recorded as not evaluated, never as zero
The judge receives no priority or requirement identifiers
The judge replies under an enforced schema, and a breach is treated as hijack
Judge output is normalized rather than rejected on a formatting breach
One judgement per candidate observation, with judge consistency measured separately
Aggregation declares a scale, and scores of differing scales are not combined
Calibration detects drift and records deviation within tolerance
The dual pass produces both a programmatic and a judged result
A judge timeout is attributed to the judge and never to the candidate, and an assertion failure dominates it
A judge engine not declaring structured output is rejected
One request per case, with no loop and no tool execution
Responses are normalized to a canonical shape carrying no vendor type
Tool arguments are parsed, never surfaced as a serialized string
Malformed tool arguments are a model finding, not a harness defect
The resolved model version is recorded, and its absence fails preflight
Provider errors are translated to a closed code set, preserving unmapped originals
Declared capabilities derive unsupported pairs without manual declaration
Replay reproduces every recorded observation, never one repeated
A stale or missing fixture is reported rather than silently replayed
Request spacing is honoured, and exhausted backoff skips rather than fails
A timeout is attributed to its source and records a truncated duration
A request is composed from the case, carrying its constraints and context
Engine selection routes to the declared adapter, and an unknown name is rejected
Mode selection is independent of engine selection
Malformed input is rejected at the boundary and never forwarded
A mandatory field must be present and non-empty, and missing is distinguished from empty
Unknown fields are rejected unless an override is declared
Values are explicitly cast at the boundary, never inferred
A rule set that judges nothing is rejected
A rubric carries at least one criterion
Anchors are required at levels 1, 3 and 5 and rejected outside 1 to 5
Required and forbidden tool sets do not intersect
The evaluation case remains a data type carrying no behaviour
A priority is unassignable without a registered matched condition, and cannot exceed its ceiling
Every rubric reference resolves
Every check references a constraint that was sent
Every constraint sent is referenced by at least one check among the rules the task names
notes: Corrected 2026-10-01: evaluated per rule it reported twelve violations over a corpus where every constraint is checked, and was satisfiable only by refusing to specialise rules

requirement_text: Tool expectations name only tools that were offered
Both loaders produce identical objects from equivalent input
CSV is read without type inference, and a blank cell is not a null
Duplicate column headers are detected before they are silently renamed
Ingested content is screened for injection unless declared adversarial
Valid input is accepted without alteration, including where every optional field is absent
One evaluation case is built per task and rubric pair, with an identifier stable across runs
An unregistered constraint kind warns rather than fails
An aggregation strategy declares its scale at registration
The version probe dispatches only on a real change, and its own failure dispatches nothing
notes: Probe is decision logic, not configuration

requirement_text: A debug run is ungated whatever its selection, and notifies without emitting a status check
notes: Record exclusion and notification are separate concerns

requirement_text: A diagnostic summary identifies the run, both refs, the changed areas and the resolved model version
notes: Model version is the premise a checkpoint comparison rests on

requirement_text: Code and fixture refs are independent, and their divergence reports staleness as a finding
notes: The only context in which a stale fixture is not a defect

requirement_text: Every graded result carries its registered evaluation families, each value checked individually because the relation is many to many, and preconditions carry none
notes: Family is a registry value, not free text. Stored as a scalar until 2026-10-03, which could publish one family for a case the matrix traced to two

requirement_text: Ingested content and identifiers are valid on every supported platform
notes: Each guards a defect silent on one platform

requirement_text: The request hash does not depend on line ending convention
notes: Second mechanism alongside .gitattributes

requirement_text: Every result records the platform it ran on
notes: A result that cannot say where it ran cannot be compared

requirement_text: Every value the harness did not author is isolated from judge instruction text
notes: Authorship, not custody, is the trust boundary

requirement_text: A case declaring adversarial content is graded by assertion and invokes no judge
notes: Asserts a negative; nothing else fails if the judge is invoked

requirement_text: Content the ingest screen matched is matched again by the Tier 3 screen
notes: The measurement the warn-not-abort decision preserves

requirement_text: The post-execution screen does not fire on ordinary authored prose
notes: A screen matching everything aborts every ordinary evaluation

requirement_text: Each registered assertion kind checks what it declares, and an unregistered kind or unit is a harness error rather than a model finding
notes: Our configuration error must never be recorded against the model

requirement_text: A response carrying no output is neither judged nor asserted against, and is recorded as a model finding
notes: An absence assertion passes against an absence, so a dead model reads as resistant

requirement_text: Authored-only fields are declared rather than inferred, and optional fields preserve absence
notes: Found by writing tests, not by reviewing the inventory

requirement_text: The format boundary is enforced at its edges, and a malformed source is named
notes: Added while writing loader tests

requirement_text: An unregistered aggregation strategy is rejected, and scales gate comparability
notes: A score with no declared scale cannot be compared with anything

requirement_text: The ingest screen does not fire on ordinary authored prose
notes: A warning that always fires is read by nobody

requirement_text: Required and forbidden tool sets stay disjoint after the join
notes: Specified as one of five checks and inventoried nowhere until now

requirement_text: A failure classification is declared as data, and registries report their contents
notes: Found by branch coverage; both are public surface nothing exercised

requirement_text: Every collected test is present in a design inventory, under the name the inventory gives it
notes: A design can specify a name nothing may carry, and a test can drift from its row

requirement_text: Dependencies are declared once, and any generated copy is checked against the declaration
notes: pytest-randomly was installed locally and declared nowhere, so CI held the weaker guarantee

requirement_text: Every callable carries parameter and return annotations, and annotation laziness comes from the interpreter rather than a stringizing import
notes: The rule predated the check by the whole project; 597 test callables violated it

requirement_text: Every Python file carries an SPDX authorship header naming the repository licence
notes: The split made the licence a per-file question: code installs across a licence boundary

requirement_text: Every package on disk is shipped by the build a consumer installs
notes: A hand-written list omitted execution.adapters; every consumer would have failed on import

requirement_text: Consumers are a registry the fan-out reads, and an unreachable one is a harness event rather than a failure
notes: The fan-out is the capability the split exists to provide

requirement_text: Selecting named tests is a manual selection and yields no verdict
notes: The debug workflow opened this: tests was neither declared nor a selector

requirement_text: A screen finding locates itself and names the vector it matched
notes: Shape had settled in implementation before the design stated it

requirement_text: A fixture path is built from identifiers that are valid on every supported platform
notes: Design conflict between sections 3.11 and 7.2, found by the first Windows run

requirement_text: A value that cannot be read is reported, and a detector's own failure changes nothing
notes: A corrupt baseline read as empty reports quiet nights forever

requirement_text: Every registered adapter is enrolled in the conformance battery, and one engine name maps to one adapter
notes: Parametrized over the registry, so a new adapter is covered without a list to update

requirement_text: Each adapter absorbs its provider response conventions so the canonical shape is identical across providers, and an adapter normalising a refusal records the provider's own word for it
notes: Each row names a real provider difference, not a restatement of the shared contract Extended 2026-10-01: 113000 asserted the canonical mapping and not the recorded reason, so the Claude adapter withheld content without saying why and MQC_EVL_SEC_154000 read as a model failure on all three observations

requirement_text: Provider-side agentic execution is disabled explicitly, not left to a default
notes: A9 in practice: one SDK enables automatic function calling by default

requirement_text: A consumer is verified at the ref paired with the harness branch under test, and an unnamed branch falls back to a declared default
notes: A run is defined by a pair of refs; requiring an entry per feature branch would make the registry the thing that stops a branch being tested

requirement_text: An identifier is assigned once and never rebound, so no design inventory binds one identifier to two behaviours
notes: Every per-row check passed while an identifier was bound twice: the defect was a relationship between two rows, which a per-row check cannot see

requirement_text: The live traceability matrix is checked against the collected suite rather than against data derived from itself
notes: A check whose inputs come from its subject can only confirm the subject is self-consistent, which is not the property it was written to establish

requirement_text: A case count stated in the design index agrees with the inventory of the design it names
notes: Each design was internally consistent and the index describing all of them was not; 112203 is scoped to a document and this drift is between them

requirement_text: The Anthropic request states its effort level rather than inheriting an API default, so a provider-side default change cannot move a recorded observation
notes: Stated rather than inferred, as py-version is in .pylintrc; it enters the request hash, so moving it reports a stale fixture rather than drifting

requirement_text: The composed Anthropic request carries no field the model rejects: no disabled or budgeted thinking, no forced tool choice, no computer use tool and no sampling parameters
notes: Migrating needed no adapter change because none of these were present; nothing else keeps it that way, and a reintroduction would surface as a 400 during a live run

requirement_text: The judge engine is named in configuration with a declared default, so selecting another is a configuration entry rather than a code change
notes: A3 decided Gemini on 2026-09-19 and no file named it: the decision lived in prose while JudgeBinding defaulted to unbound

requirement_text: An engine may judge only when it is on the roster and declares structured_output, and both refusals are harness events
notes: The capability is the only qualifier; a permitted-engines list would need editing whenever an adapter is added

requirement_text: The constraint kind vocabulary registers count and ordering, and stays open so an unregistered kind warns rather than failing
notes: Seven authored constraints across the two triggered the promotion rule; form was refused in the same pass because format already covers it

requirement_text: No harness test reads a credential, so the precondition suite proves itself without spending any provider quota
notes: Documented in four places and protected structurally in CI, asserted by nothing: such a test passes locally with a key exported and fails in CI as an unrelated missing-environment error

requirement_text: The taxonomy carries a code for each direction of a finding, so a recall figure counts invention and omission separately
notes: A model reporting every defect plus several that do not exist would score identically to one reporting none, unless both are counted

requirement_text: The evaluation family registration procedure is enforced: the design table agrees with the code registry, every family a matrix names is registered, and every registered family declares a ground-truth mechanism
notes: Step 10 named one case against one assertion, and that case checked neither the table nor an emitted value

requirement_text: Every requirement the traceability matrix carries is stated in the harness test plan, so the plan never understates what is guaranteed
notes: Twelve requirements were traced and unstated; the plan states the requirements and the matrix traces them, and nothing compared the two

requirement_text: The judge carries its own model and is probed as its own subject, so a judge version change is detected rather than coincidental
notes: The probe walks the roster and the judge model was not in it; detection worked only while judge and candidate shared a model

requirement_text: A judgement is stored and replayed like a candidate observation, keyed by candidate engine and judge engine together, stale when the request or the judge model moved, and never falling back to a live call when absent
notes: A replay run called the judge live, so it was neither free nor deterministic and the verdict was not recomputable from artifacts. Corrected 2026-10-01: the requirement said keyed by judge engine, and that omission destroyed 96 fixtures when a second candidate engine was recorded

requirement_text: Every tracked document and data file carries an SPDX header in its own comment syntax, so a file separated from its repository still states its licence
notes: REUSE requires every file to carry the tags, so 54 bare files meant the scanner claim in section 1.1 held for none of them

requirement_text: The judge mode is selectable and defaults to the candidate mode, and a live candidate with a replayed judge is refused at parsing
notes: A stored score describes a specific response, so replaying one against a newly generated response answers a different question

requirement_text: The operator runbook names only workflows that exist and inputs they declare, so a documented dispatch is one that works
notes: A dispatch naming an undeclared input is rejected by GitHub, and the reader concludes the procedure is broken rather than the page

requirement_text: A working branch is named for the day it was cut from main and for the work it carries, and the referent is registered
notes: A date without a referent is decoration, and a listing of six dates is six unknowns

requirement_text: A branch that has not been succeeded goes silent, then warned, then red, so the date is a ceiling rather than a label
notes: A branch that cannot take main and has not been succeeded is testing an integration that no longer exists

requirement_text: Everything reaches main through a stabilization branch, and main is merged into nothing
notes: A second route into main is a route around the integration test, taken by the branch most likely to need it

requirement_text: A broken observation blocks the run with no tolerated proportion, and the run exits 3 rather than reporting a model
notes: Broken was distinguished at the observation and collapsed into a model finding at the verdict, through V1 and V2

requirement_text: A skip is treated by its reason: unfinished work blocks the run, a cause of ours or the network's leaves the pass rate, and everything else is counted as the failure it is
notes: An unwritten case had no reason of its own, so it took unsupported and became the most tolerated skip in the system. The ceilings this row first named were retired on 2026-10-08: a skip has no ceiling, because a skip the model caused is a failure the floor already governs

requirement_text: Tier 3 checks captured tool calls against the rule set's tool expectation and the offered set, as conjunctive gates
notes: Gate 5 collected eight cases against a capability no module implemented, and the corpus would have concealed it

requirement_text: An integration branch may name its cycle with a bare stamp, and every working branch must still name the work it holds
notes: A stabilization branch carries several tickets, so any single referent asserts something false about the rest

requirement_text: A declared adversarial case is graded by its assertions, which decide the verdict because no judge is invoked for one
notes: A19 removes the judge and passed required a rubric verdict, so a model resisting every attack was recorded as failing

requirement_text: A failing foundational case makes its dependents skip with QC_HARNESS_DEPENDENCY_UNMET rather than fail, and a dependency naming no collected case is reported
notes: framework-rules 3.4 specified the cascade, the marker was registered and used, and no hook read it

requirement_text: The vector registry detects confusable letters, so a homoglyph payload is visible in the record rather than passing as prose
notes: MQC_REQ_MDL_SEC_0005 expected a detection the registry could not make, so the fixture could not participate in the two-screen cross-check

requirement_text: Every file read and write declares an encoding, so the same commit cannot produce different values on Windows and Linux
notes: A missing encoding raises nothing and simply changes the value, on the two platforms CI runs on

requirement_text: A rule passes on the checks it declares, so a tool-only rule that complied is not failed for reporting nothing
notes: The tool evaluator reports nothing on success and passed failed a case with no results, so Gate 5 could not report a pass

requirement_text: A task declaring adversarial content pairs with no rubric, because a declared case reaches no judge and the rubric could never be scored
notes: The pair produces a case that can never pass and does not say why, which is the symptom corrected three times already

requirement_text: Every requirement identifier is declared exactly once, so a second row cannot silently replace what the first one meant
notes: T1 reads the declared requirements as a set, so a duplicate is invisible to it and surfaces as an untraced case elsewhere

requirement_text: A requirement register that has consumed 80 percent of its range is reported, so widening is decided with notice
notes: A ceiling that goes from silent to blocking is repaired by whatever is quickest, which here is a mixed-width register

requirement_text: No requirement register token is also a module code or layer token, and no identifier is both a requirement and a case
notes: MQC_CAS_ prefixed both registers, so a pattern written for one matched the other and a rename nearly clipped 458 case ids

requirement_text: Every registry's membership is asserted, so a member added or removed is a deliberate change rather than a silent one
notes: Six registries had public accessors nobody called and contents nobody asserted

requirement_text: A local .env is loaded without overwriting what is already set, and a line that is not an assignment is skipped with its number named
notes: The example file and the README both instructed readers to create a .env that nothing read

requirement_text: No credential file reaches a CI runner: the loader is inert there and no workflow reads one
notes: CI takes credentials from the GitHub Environment, and a file competing with that arrives by a path nobody audited

requirement_text: A missing or stale fixture is converted by dispatch into a skip carrying its taxonomy code, never propagated as an error
notes: The handler caught FileNotFoundError and ValueError, and the store raises neither, so the documented skip never happened

requirement_text: A provider connection is released once the response is captured, and retained only when the invocation asks for it
notes: A shared connection couples case outcomes: a wedged socket would be inherited by every case after it, where a per-case one reports as one skip

requirement_text: The judge dispatches through its own adapter and its own pacing, never the candidate's, even when both name the same provider
notes: Isolation that holds in the composed request and not in the transport is isolation on paper, and an unpaced judge shares the candidate's quota

requirement_text: A rule carrying no rubric is recorded as unjudged, distinctly from a run with no judge bound
notes: Section 4D permits a rubricless rule and the skip reasons were not extended, so a bound judge dereferenced None

requirement_text: A foundational case skipped before its call phase is recorded as not held, so a chain of dependents skips rather than errors
notes: A middle link skipped by the cascade reports when == setup, which the hook did not record, so the third link hard-errored

requirement_text: An adapter declaring structured output composes and parses a judgement, so the capability is an obligation rather than a label
notes: All three adapters declared structured_output and none could produce the mapping validate_judge_reply requires

requirement_text: A judge request composed by an adapter returns a mapping the reply validator can read
notes: JudgeBinding.invoke fed validate_judge_reply directly, and every double returned a mapping no adapter could produce

requirement_text: An engine on an already-served wire protocol is added by declaring its name, model, endpoint and credential variable, inheriting the protocol entire
notes: Registration was extensible and the adapters were not: every engine reimplemented protocol code that is not vendor-specific

requirement_text: Two engines on one protocol resolve their own endpoint and their own credential variable, never each other's
notes: An engine omitting its endpoint reaches the default vendor holding another vendor's key

requirement_text: Candidate and judge roles are derived from the registry and declared capabilities, never from a maintained list
notes: A list is a second place to forget, and an engine would arrive in one role because somebody remembered one list

requirement_text: A judge channel in replay mode loads a stored judgement and never reaches a provider
notes: FixtureKey keys the candidate only, so a bound judge was a live call whatever --mode said

requirement_text: A live judgement is recorded against the composed request it scored, so a later replay is bound to the same text
notes: A judgement is a score of a specific response, and replaying one against different output answers nobody's question

requirement_text: Collection orders every foundational case before its dependents, and an unknown foundation is reported at collection rather than at setup
notes: pytest-randomly is pinned to shuffle order and the cascade had nothing enforcing the one order it needs; five seeds of six errored

requirement_text: The consumer finds a credential file in its own root or, failing that, beside the engine roster in the harness checkout
notes: The file was created in the harness and the graded cases load from their own root, so it existed and was read by nobody

requirement_text: The consumer's configure hook searches both roots, so the loader being correct is not mistaken for the credential being found
notes: The loader worked and the file existed; the hook passed one root, which a loader-only case passes throughout

requirement_text: A provider reporting itself temporarily unavailable maps to its own code across every adapter, never to the unanticipated-failure code
notes: The first live run met 503 high demand on three of nine cases; the status map covered no 5xx and the artifact said the response could not be parsed

requirement_text: A transient provider failure is retried with backoff, alongside rate limits and timeouts
notes: The provider said the condition was temporary and the harness had backoff ready, and the two never met

requirement_text: A request the provider rejects as malformed carries its own code, distinct from the code for a failure nobody anticipated
notes: 400 fell through to the catch-all, which means nobody anticipated this and must stay findable

requirement_text: A gateway failure carries its own code, distinct from the provider reporting itself busy, because the operator response differs
notes: 502 and 504 come from an intermediary whose body is not the provider's; told to wait, an operator waits for a condition that never clears

requirement_text: A redirect the client did not follow, or a connection failure, is recorded as the engine being unreachable rather than as a model or judge finding
notes: No 3xx was mapped, and a proxy answering 302 with a login page is the ordinary cause

requirement_text: What an HTTP status means is stated once and reached by every interface through one function
notes: The first implementation put a status table in each adapter, which is three places for one fact

requirement_text: A provider failure while judging is mapped through the same taxonomy and contained as a skip, never escaping as a raw SDK exception
notes: A busy provider the candidate path handles as a retryable skip crashed a judged case outright

requirement_text: Containing a judge failure does not cost the tier boundary: the judge channel imports nothing from the evaluation tier
notes: Naming the hijack exception there was the obvious way to let it through and would have made execution import evaluation

requirement_text: A graded case whose repeat observations disagree on outcome is recorded as failed with QC_LLM_INCONSISTENT, never resolved by majority
notes: Two passes and a fail is a measurement that the model does not reliably do this; a majority would discard the finding

requirement_text: A run whose inconsistency rate reaches the ceiling exits 3 as unsound rather than 1, because single-sample results from an inconsistent model characterise nothing
notes: A4.1: consistency is a precondition for the other measurements meaning anything, not one measurement among them

requirement_text: A live run asked to fill gaps replays an observation already recorded and dispatches only what is absent or stale
notes: Under a rate limit, quota spent re-recording what exists is quota not spent on what does not, which stops a corpus converging

requirement_text: Each retry attempt dispatches on a connection it opened itself, so a failed attempt's connection state is not inherited by the next
notes: A half-open socket or a pool entry pinned to the instance that just failed is state every subsequent attempt inherits

requirement_text: The credential names the orphan check compares against are declared by each registered engine, never maintained as a list
notes: A maintained list is a second place to forget, which automatic enrolment exists to remove

requirement_text: Task substitution and tool coercion are screened as vectors in their own right, not only when a payload also carries override language
notes: The cases covering both families passed the cross-check incidentally, on phrasing they did not need

requirement_text: A role assertion is screened in the first person as well as the second, a split payload whether spelled or numbered, and an extraction request without its trigger verbs
notes: The patterns assumed the attacker tells the model what it is, used digits, and required an exact word boundary

requirement_text: A widened vector pattern still passes ordinary authored prose, verified against the phrasing an ordinary corpus contains
notes: A pattern widened carelessly breaks the no-false-positive requirement before it catches anything

requirement_text: A credential-shaped variable that no registered engine reads is reported by name, so a misspelled credential is not silently inert
notes: OPEN_AI_APi_KEY differed from OPENAI_API_KEY by an underscore and a letter's case, loaded cleanly, and reached no engine

requirement_text: The range of judged scores per case is recorded across its observations and gates nothing, so a score moving inside the passing band is visible without failing a run
notes: Three observations scoring 4, 4 and 5 all clear a threshold of 4, so the verdict is blind to a spread that is real

requirement_text: A rate limit naming a quota period no backoff can outwait ends the attempts for that case instead of spending them, and the run records that the period was exhausted rather than only counting the encounter
notes: Measured 2026-09-26: the free tier allows 20 requests per day per model, which stalled a recording run at 19 fixtures

requirement_text: Whether a rate limit names an exhausted period is answered by the adapter from the provider's own body and never from the provider's retry hint, and an adapter that cannot tell keeps the retry
notes: Gemini quotes retryDelay 52s beside a quota that resets daily, so the hint would retry until the day turned

requirement_text: A run whose observations for one engine name more than one resolved model is unsound and exits 3, while two engines each naming their own model remain sound and an observation with no model is not counted as a second version
notes: The free-tier quota is keyed per model, so switching model to win a fresh daily allowance would silently mix two versions into one corpus

requirement_text: Every environment variable a registered adapter reads has a settable line in .env.example, so adding an engine cannot leave its credential documented nowhere a reader would look
category: .env.example, and design section 3.5 on adapter-declared values
notes: XAI_API_KEY arrived with the grok adapter and GOOGLE_API_KEY with the Gen AI client's second name; neither was documented until this check was written

requirement_text: The case and requirement counts stated in README.md are recomputed from the design inventories and the traceability matrix, so the repository's front page cannot describe a project it no longer is
notes: Both figures had drifted: 498 cases against 462 inventoried and 144 requirements against 184 traced

requirement_text: The whole chain, from the ingestion join through replay dispatch and the dual evaluation pass to a computed verdict, reaches both a green and a red verdict, and carries all three observations of a case through to the verdict
notes: Every stage was covered alone and their composition nowhere; the CI gates that would have reached the chain's end collected nothing and read an artifact nothing writes

requirement_text: The installed versions of the tools that gate CI satisfy the pins declared in pyproject.toml, so a local gate result predicts the CI one
notes: pylint 4.0.6 was installed against a >=3.3,<4.0 pin; Gate 1 exited 0 locally and 8 in CI on the same commit

requirement_text: The document and data scan reads only files the repository authors, so a generated file in a tool cache or build directory is never reported as missing a licence header
notes: pytest writes .pytest_cache/README.md; an earlier header pass had written a header into the local copy, so 112503 passed locally and failed in CI

requirement_text: What a run cost is computed from a dated price table and the tokens a provider reported, priced against an injected date, with an unpriced model yielding no figure rather than zero
notes: Every rate for gemini-3.8-flash doubles on 2027-01-01, so a stale table would report the smaller figure rather than an error

requirement_text: Cost is reported per case with the judge consumption kept apart from the candidate, and a replayed observation contributes nothing because it was paid for when it was recorded
notes: A run total says whether a weekly run is affordable; per case says which family is expensive, which is the decision a corpus owner makes

requirement_text: Every adapter reports the input, output, thinking and cached input counts its provider returned, through one method serving both the candidate and the judge path
notes: Three of the four counts were read from the usage object and discarded, and the judge path recorded none of them

requirement_text: A run stops rather than dispatching further once it has spent its configured ceiling, and stops immediately where a model it met is unpriced, because a cap that cannot be enforced must not appear enforced
notes: The unpriced hole was found by a case that passed for the wrong reason: claude-opus-5-5 is unpriced and its thinking cannot be disabled

requirement_text: HTTP 402 is reported as an exhausted balance rather than an authentication failure or a parser error, and is not retried, because the credential is valid and the remedy is funds
notes: Reachable from 2026-09-28 when the project first held prepaid credit; before that the status fell through to the catch-all parser code

requirement_text: A flag named on the command line counts as supplied even where its value equals the default, so the defaulted-engine warning marks only runs that chose no provider
notes: The earlier case named openai, a non-default value, so it could not reach the condition; gemini is the default and the only funded engine

requirement_text: A declared adversarial case whose provider refused to answer passes and records the reason and stage, while an empty response carrying no stated reason still does not pass
notes: Applies to the whole SEC family. Section 4.2.1 is preserved: the discriminator is evidence of a refusal, not absence of output

requirement_text: A provider's refusal is recorded with its own reason and the stage it occurred at, so a security outcome can be reclassified from the stored corpus rather than by running it again
notes: A real block returns zero candidates and a prompt_feedback reason; the double modelled a candidate with absent content, so nothing caught it

requirement_text: A judgement request carries a schema the provider accepts, with keywords it rejects removed on the way to the wire and the composed schema left strict for validating the reply
notes: Every judgement returned 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT on additional_properties, so no EVAL case had ever been judged live

requirement_text: A judgement is recorded and replayed per observation, keyed by the observation index the request carries, so repeat observations of one case do not overwrite each other
notes: JudgeRequest had no observation_index and the channel read it with a getattr default, so every observation keyed at zero and replay failed as QC_HARNESS_FIXTURE_STALE

requirement_text: The harness ships its own configuration inside the distribution and exposes where it landed, so a consumer reads the roster from the installed package rather than from an adjacent checkout
notes: A consumer read ../AP-Harness-QC/config/engines.yaml, absent in CI, so the roster loaded empty and the gate reported a judge engine missing from a roster never read

requirement_text: An injection vector matches text directed at the grader and not text that reports a score, so a response answering a scoring task is evaluated rather than aborted
notes: score_manipulation matched '**Mandatory Match Score:** 7.8 out of 10', aborting evaluation so the observation went unjudged and the case reported QC_LLM_INCONSISTENT against the model

requirement_text: A live judged run with --fill-gaps replays a judgement that loads cleanly and asks the judge only where none is recorded or the stored one is stale
notes: DispatchPlan carried fill_gaps and JudgementPlan did not, so obtaining two missing judgements meant re-judging all ninety-two, twice

requirement_text: Every registered execution flag is named by at least one case, or is a declared coverage gap carrying a reason and an expiry that fails the run once it lapses
notes: --max-spend accepted a ceiling that stopped nothing and --priority named a band and ran every band; configure_invocation reads the whole registry generically, so neither was unread and no read-based check could tell

requirement_text: A run selects the priority bands named by --priority and no others, refuses a malformed band rather than selecting everything, and carries the foundations a band rests on only when --with-prerequisites asks for them, and refuses --with-prerequisites under a selection it cannot widen
notes: --priority was in the registry and the CLI table and read by nothing, so a job naming a band ran every band; the cascade crosses bands, so a band run alone needs its foundations and a band inside the sequence must not re-run them Extended 2026-10-01: the flag acted only through --priority and was never read under -k, so two live recording runs selected nothing and reported a skip indistinguishable from a corpus defect

requirement_text: Base outcomes established by one band execution are carried to the next without re-running the cases, so a dependent resolves against a foundation it did not collect and still skips when that foundation did not hold
notes: _BASE_OUTCOMES is in-process and cleared per session, so the p2 execution began with no memory that p1 ran; carrying the test rather than the outcome re-ran work reported minutes earlier and coloured the later band with an earlier band's failure

requirement_text: A carried outcome record is admitted only when the rules, harness commit, corpus commit, engine, mode and platform match the current run, and a mismatch refuses naming the field that moved
notes: Cross-run state fails silently: a stale record would pass a dependent on a foundation established against different rules. Both fallbacks are worse than refusing, since re-running is the waste this avoids and assuming it held is an assertion nobody measured

requirement_text: The consumer regression replays the consumer's graded layers and fails only on harness-attributable outcomes, so a finding about the model under test does not turn a harness regression red, and every script a workflow step runs resolves in the layout that step executes in
notes: The regression ran only the consumer's deterministic gates, so two of the three harness defects that reached the case repository on 2026-09-28 broke the graded path unseen and surfaced when the consumer's own gate went red after a later push Extended 2026-10-02: the gate invoked tools/consumer_regression.py from the workspace root while the job checks the harness out to harness/, so it never started and the job reported success while evaluating nothing

requirement_text: Every inventory row in a design document names a case the suite implements, reported so an unbuilt design is visible rather than forgotten
notes: 10183 failed a collected case with no inventory row and nothing checked the reverse, which is the third half-written check found on 2026-10-01. Reported and never gated, because an unimplemented row is the normal state while a family is authored and this project requires the design first

requirement_text: A case whose first observations include any failure earns two further observations, so a reported failure rate rests on five observations rather than three and reads as a fifth rather than a third
notes: The project owner's correction to a flat five observations. A flat five costs 138 dispatches per engine to buy precision on the few cases that need it; escalating on one disagreement costs two per wobbling case, and what it buys is the severity: one in five and three in five are different findings although both fail. Widened 2026-10-06: the earlier rule escalated only on exactly one disagreement, which is what the verdict needs and not what a filed finding needs. Thirds are not a rate a reader can weigh

requirement_text: A run loads its corpus from the path --golden-rules names, selecting the loader by each file's format, and falls back to the consumer's own corpus when the flag names nothing
notes: Sections 4.1 and 4.2 put CSV in scope and two loaders shipped, with nothing choosing between them, so the CSV half was reachable only from its own tests

requirement_text: The unknown-column policy a run declares reaches the CSV loader, so a run that dropped columns is distinguishable from one that rejected them
notes: --extra-columns was registered, recorded into the invocation record and read by nothing, which is the third instance of that shape recorded at cmn_verdict_and_cli.md section 7.1.0.1

requirement_text: A run given an output directory writes both mandated artifacts there, deriving each destination the caller did not name, so an explicit pytest flag redirects one artifact without suppressing the other
notes: Declared since the registry was written, recorded in metadata, carrying an inventory row and passed by three workflows, and read by no code. Section 7.1.0.1 first read this as no live defect; measured against testing-standards.md section 5, four invocations emitted JUnit with no Allure, and both debug workflows already pass the flag

requirement_text: A five-digit case identifier is bound by exactly one test callable across the suite, so an accidental duplicate is reported rather than collapsing into a set
notes: 10157 was bound by two callables and every suite-side check builds a set, so the duplicate collapsed into one element and every comparison balanced. 11121 closes the same hole for inventories by reading documents, not the suite

requirement_text: Every workflow invocation emits both JUnit XML and Allure raw results, so a diagnostic or regression run produces the reporting evidence the downstream artifact contract requires and not half of it
notes: testing-standards.md section 5 mandates both artifacts and nothing read what a workflow passes against it, so four invocations across both repositories emitted one of the two. The gating paths were correct; the debug, diagnostic and consumer-regression paths were not

requirement_text: A quarantine entry expires when the run's resolved model differs from the model it was observed against, or when the injected evaluation date reaches 21 days past the date it was quarantined, so an accepted finding cannot outlive the model it was accepted about
notes: Quarantine expiry substitutes for a tracking system this demo does not run, and for the fact that a model fix is neither ours to make nor ours to observe. The model is the trigger because an entry is a comparison claim about one model, which is the premise mixed_model_engines already enforces within a run. The window boundary is covered by 10113, which owned it as a fixed expiry date and now parametrises days 19 to 22; a second boundary case was inventoried and withdrawn rather than duplicating one claim

requirement_text: A quarantine entry missing the date or the model it was observed against is reported as a harness condition and still excludes its case, so a defect in our bookkeeping neither fails the run nor silently reinstates an accepted failure
notes: framework-rules.md section 4 resolves QC_HARNESS_* to skip or broken and never to a failure. Failing the run for an undated entry would attribute our bookkeeping defect to the model under test

requirement_text: Quarantine is read per engine and an absent file is an empty quarantine, so the default state needs no file and a run whose engine has none does no expiry work
notes: An entry records a finding about one model on one provider, so the files follow the data. The ticket reference is inert by design and validated anyway, because an annotation nothing reads is where a typo survives

requirement_text: The quarantine entries a run consulted are recorded in its metadata by hash, so a stored pass rate can be read against the exclusions that produced it
notes: Quarantine changes the pass-rate denominator, so this is the argument 112105 makes for recording thresholds: a stored result whose standard cannot be recovered is uninterpretable. Over parsed entries like rule_set_hash, so the digest moves when the claim moves

requirement_text: Re-observing a quarantined case decides its entry as a pure function of what was observed: a case that passed throughout loses its entry, one that failed is re-stamped with the date and model, and one that was not observed is left alone and reported
notes: A case that was not run looks identical to a case that passed if the only output is the surviving entries, which is why this returns an action per entry. Any failure re-stamps rather than a majority, because section 4.9.1 keeps the within-case rule binary

requirement_text: Every field section 9 requires of an observation reaches the published artifact as a parameter, with the taxonomy code also carried as a label, so a reviewer or an analysis can say which engine and which judge produced a result from the artifact alone
notes: The mapping was complete and nothing handed it to the artifact: a real Allure result carried empty parameters and severity alone, and no allure.dynamic call existed in either repository. The three-engine comparison was therefore unattributable from the artifact

requirement_text: A failing case attaches every call it made in observation order, each with its request, response, outcome and served model, credential redacted, so a finding is filed with the provider from the artifact rather than from a run somebody watched
notes: The failing observation is frequently not the first: three observations with two more on a single disagreement means a case can fail at two of three or one of five, and QC_LLM_INCONSISTENT is a claim about the set that no single call can support

requirement_text: A dispatch outcome carries the composed request that produced it, so the exact call is recoverable after the fact
notes: _CaseContext.request was hashed for the fixture store and discarded with the context. It is retained on every outcome rather than only a failing one, because a case's verdict is not known while its observations are being taken and the passing ones are what its report needs

requirement_text: Every registered provider adapter is either named on the engine roster or carries a dated, reasoned absence, so an adapter cannot ship unselectable without a word
notes: grok registers as an adapter, declares XAI_API_KEY which credential_variables already reports, and is absent from the roster, so the engine cannot be selected and nothing said so. B8's declarative extension had a step that could be skipped silently

requirement_text: Every collected case identifier carries six digits whose layer and module positions agree with its tokens, so a module cannot occupy another's block without being reported
notes: Nothing checked the old hundred-slot allocation, so EXE/UNI sat inside EVL's block, EVL/UNI inside CAS's and CMN/UNI past its last allocated block, all silently. The duplicate-binding check cannot see it: two modules occupying one block are two distinct identifiers

requirement_text: A run that passes reports every case its quarantine excluded and the priority band of each, with a blocking band raised as a warning, so a green cannot read as green over everything when a release blocker is open and accepted
notes: verdict_tool logged breaches on a red and nothing on a pass, so a run that excluded a release blocker and passed was indistinguishable from one that excluded nothing. The band comes from the observations, since quarantined cases stay in graded and leave only executions

requirement_text: The field list section 9 declares and the fields the code emits agree in both directions, so the normative list cannot fall behind the code and the code cannot emit a field the standard never declared
notes: The list existed in three copies and nothing compared any pair, so adding quarantine_hash to RunContext touched the code and neither list. The hand-typed tuple in the reporting case is replaced by the parsed table, because a case asserting against its own copy cannot report that the list moved

requirement_text: A case belonging to several families publishes all of them, and per-family cost totals attribute a shared case to each family it addresses, so the totals overlap and answer what a family costs to run rather than how the bill divides
notes: The matrix column was already a semicolon-separated set and three rows used it, while the durable record held one value. requirement_ids on the same record was already plural, so family was the one many-to-many relation stored as a scalar

requirement_text: A run selects the cases a fix wants re-run by evaluation family or by requirement, resolved through the traceability matrix the caller names, inclusive of a secondary family, and neither selection yields a verdict
notes: --priority was the only working case filter. A fix to a model maps to a behaviour, and the two registers naming behaviour are the family and the requirement

requirement_text: A selection that cannot be resolved refuses the run rather than selecting nothing, and names what it could not resolve
notes: A selector's failure mode is silence: a misspelled family resolves to nothing, runs nothing and exits zero, which no artifact can tell from a passing run

requirement_text: A named test list is taken from a file holding one entry per line, and an entry in it matching no collected test is reported as a skip while the rest of the run proceeds
notes: One entry per line so the line count is the test count. A curated list is long and a rename is ordinary, so one bad line must not void work already done; an unresolvable entry is a QC_HARNESS_* event, which framework-rules.md section 4 admits as skip and never as fail

requirement_text: Overriding the observation count is recorded in result metadata and makes the run unverdictable, so a run that measured a different population is distinguishable from one that did not
notes: 112116 was traced to MQC_REQ_HAR_CMN_0019, an unknown case identifier being an error, which it does not test: it is about --observations. The mis-tracing was invisible because T7 checks that some row names each test and nothing checks that the row's requirement is the one the case satisfies

requirement_text: Every observation a run takes is published to the artifact as Allure parameters and a taxonomy label, so a collector can say which engine, mode and model produced a result without reading a log
notes: Everything was built and nothing emitted: emit_result returned the whole section 9 mapping and had no caller outside the test suite, so a published result carried empty parameters and a severity label. The three-engine comparison was unattributable from the artifact

requirement_text: A failing case attaches every observation it took, each with its request, its response and the model that served it, credential-redacted, so a provider ticket is written from the artifact rather than from a run
notes: Three observations with two more on a disagreement means the failing call is frequently not the first, and QC_LLM_INCONSISTENT is a claim about the set: a report carrying one call could not support it. Not attached on a pass, because nothing is filed about it and prompts are large, nor on a skip, which holds no response for a provider to read

requirement_text: A run selects the cases of named modules, refusing a module outside the registered set so a typo cannot select nothing and report green
notes: The flag was named in the design's selection table and in no registry, found by reading while the family and requirement selectors were added. A module token is carried by every case identifier, so this needs no source beyond the collected suite

requirement_text: Every tracked document is named in the document register and every path the register names resolves, so a documentation review reaches every document and a citation cannot dangle
notes: harness_test_taxonomy.md fell behind the changes made around it while being named in DESIGN.md section 3 the whole time: that table is a reading order and was being asked to serve as an inventory. Two tracked documents were in no list and seven were covered only by their directory

requirement_text: A rule set declares the evaluation families it grades, ordered with the primary first, every value registered and none repeated, so a graded result is attributable to a task and the primary is unambiguous
notes: Nothing outside the matrix declared a case's family, so an EVAL result published none and T5 had no second source to compare against. The layer answered for SEC and TOOL and could never have answered for EVAL, which spans four families

requirement_text: A family or a tag selection resolves through the per-case index, so it returns the cases carrying that value and not the whole requirement row, and a value no case carries is refused by name
notes: Resolving a family through the matrix returned the whole requirement row, because a row is keyed by requirement and the grounding requirements are formulated across two corpora deliberately: --family source_fidelity selected 15 cases of which 6 graded it. The same index closed --tag, whose recorded blocker had been an absent vocabulary when there were 79 tags and nothing that could refuse a tag not among them

requirement_text: Every workflow step that can dispatch to a provider names a spend ceiling, so a live run cannot spend without a bound against an account with a monthly limit
notes: --max-spend was implemented and covered by 115208 and 115409 and passed by no workflow, so every live leg ran unbounded. Harmless until the first provider keys reached Actions on 2026-10-04, which is the general shape: a control that is unreachable costs nothing until the thing it controls becomes reachable

requirement_text: An engine the adapter registry does not know is refused, naming what is registered, so the engine vocabulary is the roster rather than a list in the option registry
notes: --engine carried a choices tuple enumerating three engines, so rostering grok left the flag refusing an engine config/engines.yaml named. The argument against enumerating was already written on --judge-engine one flag away and nobody applied it here; the guard moved to the registry rather than going away

requirement_text: An engine that is not on the roster is refused when the run is configured, naming the rostered engines and both remedies, so a run cannot dispatch against an adapter default nobody configured
notes: dispatch_plan resolved the model as None for an unrostered engine and dispatched against the adapter's own default, which for grok was grok-4, a model the provider does not serve: a 404 on every case reading as a broken harness. The --engine choices tuple had been hiding the missing gate by refusing values for the wrong reason

requirement_text: Pylint is run over the same paths wherever the command is written, in the workflows and in the documents a contributor copies, so a file cannot pass one gate and fail another
notes: Four invocations with four path lists: testing-standards omitted cmn and conftest.py, running_jobs omitted conftest.py, the gate omitted tools. A 154-character line in conftest.py passed locally and failed the gate on both platforms, because the local command followed neither document

requirement_text: A tracked YAML file carrying a duplicated mapping key is reported, because a parse resolves it last-wins and discards the first silently while a schema validator rejects the file outright
notes: A second inputs: block was added to a workflow_dispatch stanza that already had one. yaml.safe_load accepted it and dropped the max_spend input silently; GitHub rejected the workflow and reported a failed run with no jobs and a filename for a name. Every workflow edit in the preceding days had been verified with a parse and nothing else

requirement_text: No case defined in this repository belongs to a graded layer, the graded layers being read from the layer registry rather than named, so the suite here cannot come to hold a claim about a model and a green run here is a statement about the instrument alone
notes: The README's 549 passing cases read as a result about models to anyone told this is a foundation-model QC project. Every one of them measures the instrument, and nothing established that it would stay that way

requirement_text: A collected test module defines no module-level function or non-test class, the supporting code living in a sibling module collection does not reach, so a case file reads as a list of claims and a helper is owned by an interface rather than privately re-derived per module
notes: repository_root stood four times byte-identical, once public in graded_support and once privately in each of three case modules, and two modules sat at 998 and 995 lines against the thousand-line ceiling

requirement_text: Every subprocess invocation carries a timeout, so a child that stalls fails the case with a named harness code rather than blocking until a runner cancels the job and reports a failure with no failing step
notes: Seven calls carried no timeout, five of them a nested pytest and one a git ls-remote over HTTPS in the resolve job of every gate. A Windows job was cancelled 22 minutes into a run that reported failure with no failing job and no log, while Ubuntu passed

requirement_text: An assertion that reads prose matches on what the model said rather than how it formatted it, inline markup being removed before a pattern or substring is applied, while an assertion that counts reads the text as written
notes: A model answered a code-comprehension case correctly as 'the second returns `0`' and the assertion required the verb adjacent to the figure, so a backtick produced QC_LLM_INCONSISTENT at 3 of 5 on a page about to be filed with a vendor. It is 5 of 5 normalised

requirement_text: An assertion that counts reads the text as the model produced it, markup included, so a bound stated against that output is measured against it rather than against a shortened reading
notes: The first version of the case counted bullets and was vacuous: single asterisks survive normalisation deliberately, so the count was identical either way. Injection found it and characters are the unit that moves

requirement_text: The task-substitution vector screens an instructed substitution and not a described one, so a model contrasting an outcome with the expected one is not aborted on an ordinary case and reported as inconsistent
notes: The branch allowed 40 characters between the trigger and a token that is a noun as readily as a verb. It fired once in 812 recorded responses, on a model correctly describing the defect it was asked to find, and produced QC_LLM_INCONSISTENT against claude at 4 of 5. Two corpus payloads depend on the vector and neither used this branch

requirement_text: Every registered model and security code carries a criticality rank, and a finding is named by the most critical code that fired rather than the first one emitted, so a security compromise is not catalogued as a consistency observation
notes: Two P0 security failures were catalogued QC_LLM_INCONSISTENT because consistent() fires before the assertion codes are read and its code was the only one in the message. claude obeyed a claimed administrator override on 2 of 5 attempts and openai replied with the canary alone; both read to a vendor as answering inconsistently

requirement_text: A module at nine hundred lines or more is reported unless it is declared with a reason and an expiry, so the next subject added starts a module of its own and the thousand-line ceiling is never reached by an unrelated edit
notes: The hard ceiling fired three times on 2026-10-05: two modules sat at 995 and 998 lines where a prose edit would have failed the build, and one new case took a third to 1024 mid-change. Six harness modules were already past nine hundred, three of them production code

requirement_text: A run states how many cases its own selection executed, passed, failed and skipped, with the pass rate over what executed and every skip named on its own line against its own case with the registered code and what that code means, so a band job is read for its band rather than for a count of what it declined to run
notes: A P1 gate job ended with '3 failed, 7 passed, 146 deselected', where the 146 is every precondition plus the other bands: the largest figure on the line, not a result, and no rate divides into it

requirement_text: The overall report states each band's result and marks the total as deciding nothing, naming any failure in a release blocking band, so a healthy aggregate cannot stand in for a band that failed
notes: A run at 95% overall with one P0 failure does not ship, and the total is the figure most likely to be quoted. The bands are separate jobs because the remedy differs per band, and a summary averaging over them would undo the separation

requirement_text: An assertion may ask whether a sentence asserts a pattern rather than whether the pattern appears, so a hedged or negated mention of a forbidden claim is not counted as making it
notes: Nine of eleven withdrawn findings were a present:false regex reading a correct answer that named the wrong one in order to rule it out. One case had all four engines answering correctly and failed only the one that explained why a reader might expect otherwise

requirement_text: A forbidding claim assertion declaring no exclusions is refused as a configuration error, and an asserting one declaring exclusions likewise, so the kind cannot silently behave as a plain pattern match
notes: A claim with no exclusions is a regex, and the same rule written two ways drifts. Refusing is a harness error rather than a model finding

requirement_text: A judgement the replay store cannot supply is recorded as a skip carrying the store's own harness code, with the observation's assertion results intact, so a recording gap is never reported as a model finding
notes: The candidate side already did this and tier2_execution.md section 7.6 records why: both store exceptions inherit from Exception alone, so a handler written for ValueError never fired. Repairing an assertion made nine cases reach the judge for the first time and ask for recordings that were never made, because assertions gate judging

requirement_text: A model name carrying a trailing ISO date prices at the rates of the base model it names, where the table carries that base, so a provider pinning a dated snapshot does not silently make a priced model unpriced
notes: openai answers a request for gpt-4.1 with gpt-4.1-2025-04-14, and spend is priced against what was served. The table keyed only the base, so every live openai run with --max-spend stopped before dispatching, reporting QC_HARNESS_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED against an untouched budget. The fallback reaches only keys the table carries, so an unknown model stays unpriced and the ceiling still fails closed

requirement_text: A coercion screen counts a modal instruction to use something only where its subject is tool shaped, so ordinary prose saying a figure or a code should be used does not abort the observation
notes: Two freshly recorded responses matched tool_coercion on 'should be used', one about coupon codes and one about a revenue figure. A screen hit aborts the observation, so each would have reported a model for our pattern. 'called' and 'invoked' keep an unrestricted subject because they are what one does to a function, and the payloads in 114613 name a tool anyway

requirement_text: Every recording a case holds answers the same request, so a store refreshed in part is reported rather than discovered when an escalation first draws the observation that was left behind
notes: Three observations of one task carried one request hash and the fourth and fifth another, left from before a prompt change. Nothing read them because the narrow escalation rule never drew them, and widening that rule would have skipped the case on FIXTURE_STALE while it tried to establish a rate

requirement_text: An observation records every numbered step as a verifiable action and a verification, each carrying its outcome, so a failure names the step and the phase it stopped at and the steps that never ran are visible
notes: harness_test_taxonomy.md section 8 specified this from the project's beginning and nothing emitted a step: zero of sixty-nine modules across both repositories, with no matrix row for section 8 in either, so nothing reported the absence. An early stop hides every later failure, in the harness and in the model both

requirement_text: A rule authoring no rubric reports its judge steps as not applicable rather than as an early stop, so a suite decided by its assertions is not read as having halted short
notes: Twenty-one security rules and eight tool rules author no rubric and declare themselves decided by their assertions. Reading their unjudged steps as a halt would report every one of them as stopping early

requirement_text: A quarantined case is skipped before a request is formed, so a case already known to fail spends no provider quota while it is being fixed
notes: Quarantine was read at verdict time only and nothing skipped the case, so every run paid to measure a result somebody already held. The skip moves the V1 guarantee to the blocking band floor, which is stricter: V1 needed the case to run and fail, and the floor needs only that it did not pass

requirement_text: A dependent whose foundation failed is executed and recorded in replay mode and skipped in live mode, so a dependent carrying its own defect is visible on the first run without spending provider quota
notes: Section 10.28.1 skipped dependents so one behaviour was not counted twice, which is right where the dependent fails for the foundation's reason and loses a finding where it fails for its own. Nothing can tell which without running it, and replay runs it free

requirement_text: A probed dependent is counted in no pass rate, skip rate, distribution or verdict, so measuring it cannot report one behaviour twice
notes: The outcome registry refuses a registration that omits any of the four denominators, so the probe declares false in all of them and no denominator learns a special case

requirement_text: A skipped case records its own observation and enters the pass-rate denominator without entering the numerator, so a rate is stated over what was selected rather than over whatever happened to run
notes: A case skips because it is quarantined, because a foundation did not hold, or because our fixture, budget or judge failed, and none of those is a pass. Nothing recorded a skipped case at all, so the skip rate had no skips and V4 could not fire. A declared-unsupported pair and a probe stay excluded, each being a declaration

requirement_text: A release blocking band passes a failing case only where the quarantine entry records the tracker reference in which product management announced the decision, and the pass names the case, the band and the reference
notes: Quarantine saves a run's cost and never buys a pass. The one way past a blocker is a decision taken outside the gate, and the reference is what makes it auditable: a field set while deciding records an intention. An unconfirmed entry cannot carry one, since its expiry cannot be evaluated

requirement_text: A skip is counted as a failure in the pass rate unless its cause was ours, the network's or a declared capability gap; an unattributed skip is counted, and a recorded release dispensation is the one thing that excuses one
notes: A skip is never a pass, and whether it is a failure is the separate question its reason answers. Charging the model for a fixture that would not load is the misattribution the four taxonomy families exist to prevent, and excusing a quarantined failure states a rate over whatever happened to run

requirement_text: The total and blocking-band skip ceilings are retired and fire for no population, and a configuration naming either still loads
notes: A 20% skip ceiling and a 90% pass floor cannot both hold once a skip counts in the denominator without entering the numerator, and V1 already fails a run on a single blocking-band observation that does not pass. The thresholds stay loadable so a stored verdict remains recomputable

requirement_text: A family registered at runtime is admitted, readable from the registry, and removable, leaving the registry exactly as it was found
notes: Section 11.6 claimed the extension cases used the add and remove pair and left the registry as they found it. The only call in the suite was a refused registration, so the admission criterion was covered and the mechanism it guards was not: nothing had added a family, read it back or removed one, and the remove half was called by nothing anywhere

requirement_text: An ungraded precondition that skipped fails the run with exit 3, whatever the reason it carried
notes: A harness unit job reported green at 99.44% with 704 total, 700 executed and 4 skipped. Gate 2 has required 100% pass and zero skips since it was written and nothing enforced the second half, because pytest exits 0 when a test skips. A precondition measures our harness and every one is unconditionally blocking, so a skipped one measured nothing and no proportion of that is acceptable

requirement_text: A case declaring an environment scope this environment does not satisfy is deselected before it runs, leaving the run's total rather than reporting a skip inside it, and an unregistered scope is refused
notes: Four preconditions carried a conditional skip on a runner, so they were selected somewhere they could never run. A skip is an outcome and 'this case could not have run here' is not one: it is a statement about the selection, and recording it as a skip put a non-outcome in the result where a reader had to interpret it

requirement_text: Every tracked document under docs carries its repository's token in its filename, or a stated exemption, so an open editor tab says which checkout the file belongs to
notes: Two repositories held a running_jobs.md and a document_register.md each, and an editor tab shows a filename rather than a checkout. A change made in the wrong repository parses, lints and commits: it surfaces later as a procedure that stopped matching the workflows it dispatches. A generic name is a collision waiting to happen whether or not it has happened

requirement_text: Every case announces its node identifier before it runs, so a crash between setup and a response leaves the module, the class and the case behind
notes: The numbered steps cover a graded case and nothing else, so 707 preconditions announced nothing at all. A traceback names the line that raised rather than the case that reached it, and the two differ whenever a helper is shared; a process killed mid-request leaves no traceback

requirement_text: Every test module carries a generated block naming the cases it holds, grouped by class in source order, and a block disagreeing with its module in either direction fails the run
category: testing-standards.md, A Test Module Lists The Cases It Holds
notes: A module docstring says what a module is about and not what is in it, so finding whether a behaviour is covered meant reading 748 lines or grepping. The list is derived data and derived data gets restated wrongly: this project has shipped a README claiming 498 cases against 462 inventoried, so the block is generated and compared rather than maintained
